transcript: Galaxies did not begin with the same chemical ingredients they have today. Astronomers call the chemical richness of a galaxy's gas its metallicity. This paper studies five extremely early galaxies. Because none is magnified by gravitational lensing, the team avoids a correction that can distort the galaxy's estimated masses. Their oxygen abundance is about 0.7 decks below nearby galaxies of similar mass. That means roughly five times lower. The results stay similar when researchers change the local comparison or remove one galaxy at a time. But the sample is small and the absolute abundance scale remains uncertain.
